accepted.firewall: Phase A code reads no RNA/ATAC matrix values; no correspondence is constructed.

A1_control_exclusion_universe.contract: Control must not overlap ANY E2 distal partner OF THAT PROMOTER.
A1_control_exclusion_universe.code: Builds one global `forb` interval index from all E2 distal intervals and rejects any candidate overlapping any E2 distal from any promoter.
A1_control_exclusion_universe.consequence: Control eligibility is stricter than frozen and depends on unrelated promoters' distal occupancy; the 4,514 drop count and 15,646 retained count are not contract-compliant.
A1_control_exclusion_universe.required: Index forbidden E2 distal intervals by promoter_key and apply only the fixed promoter's distal partners (which includes the linked distal).

A2_C3_roundtrip_missing.contract: Same frozen C3 lift rule: v479, minMatch 0.95, single mapping, same chromosome, exact length, exact round trip.
A2_C3_roundtrip_missing.code: Checks forward mapping, multiplicity, chromosome and length only. No hg38→hg19 reverse lift and exact-coordinate round-trip assertion is performed.
A2_C3_roundtrip_missing.consequence: Controls that would fail the frozen C3 identity gate can enter the admissible pool. This directly affects the funnel and control coordinates.
A2_C3_roundtrip_missing.required: Run the same reverse-chain exact round-trip test used by C3 and reject any candidate not returning exactly to its original hg19 interval.

A3_direction_rule_not_followed.contract: Control may lie on either side; side is drawn with the frozen seed and recorded.
A3_direction_rule_not_followed.code: Enumerates both sides and draws uniformly over all admissible candidate windows. Therefore side probability is proportional to the number of admissible windows on each side.
A3_direction_rule_not_followed.consequence: The side is not a frozen random draw and can become associated with accessibility/liftability/support density.
A3_direction_rule_not_followed.required: Implement the frozen side draw explicitly per linked edge before control selection, record it, and apply a prospectively defined fail-closed rule if that side has no admissible control. Do not switch sides after observing failure unless the governing contract is prospectively superseded.

A4_second_control_draw_missing.contract: One primary control draw plus a SECOND independent control draw reserved solely for the control-vs-control null.
A4_second_control_draw_missing.code: Emits one CONTROL row per retained linked edge and no second independent control.
A4_second_control_draw_missing.consequence: The anti-false-green control-control null cannot be executed from this Stage-3 artifact as frozen.
A4_second_control_draw_missing.required: Generate and persist the second independent control draw under the frozen seed semantics, separately labelled and never substituted for the primary.

A5_anchor_frequency_wrong_definition.contract: anchor_frequency = number of distinct E2 promoters whose distal partners overlap this interval.
A5_anchor_frequency_wrong_definition.code: `anc[f'{chrom}:{distal_start_hg38}'] += 1` and later exact-start lookup; controls use exact start or zero.
A5_anchor_frequency_wrong_definition.consequence: This is an exact-start multiplicity, not interval-overlap distinct-promoter frequency. It changes a frozen nuisance covariate central to NEG_ANCHOR and the estimator basis.
A5_anchor_frequency_wrong_definition.required: Compute interval-overlap counts of DISTINCT promoter keys against each linked/control interval, using the frozen E2 distal set.

A6_candidate_search_not_exhaustive.finding: The producer describes an 'exhaustive scan', but candidate starts are sampled on a deterministic grid with `step=max(1000,(hi-lo)//60)`. This is not enumeration of all admissible 5-kb placements in the matched distance band.
A6_candidate_search_not_exhaustive.consequence: `DROP_NO_ADMISSIBLE_CONTROL_AFTER_LIFT` still partly reflects the proposal lattice. The 15,646 count cannot be interpreted as the full contract-testable population without a prospectively defined candidate universe.
A6_candidate_search_not_exhaustive.required: Freeze the candidate universe before rerun. Prefer an exact interval-based sampler over admissible hg19 start ranges, or a clearly predeclared base-pair/grid lattice justified before results. Do not call the current grid exhaustive.

A7_artifact_receipt_not_fully_bound.finding: Receipt producer.git_blob is null and receipt does not contain SHA-256 of the emitted Stage-3 structural NPZ, despite the Stage-3 artifact contract requiring producer Git/blob provenance and artifact digest binding.
A7_artifact_receipt_not_fully_bound.required: Successor receipt must bind the exact producer Git blob and every emitted artifact SHA-256.
